title: A rational obstruction to strong chromatic splitting at height three
main_claim: For p>=5 the canonical map L_0 L_{K(3)}S -> L_0 L_{K(2)} L_{K(3)}S is nonzero on pi_{-3}. Hence L_2 L_{K(3)}S is not equivalent to Hopkins' predicted wedge W_3: in W_3 the degree -3 rational class lives in the K(2)-acyclic L_1 summand, so tau vanishes in that degree.
coverage:
Partial audit, independent of the first pass on this paper. Checked:
- Wedge-obstruction lemma and Corollary 1.2. The W_3 summand degrees agree with Hovey's rule that the monomial with largest index i goes to L_{n-i}.
- Ordinary detector and K(2)-locality of D.
- Finite-amplitude descent convergence and the central-weight vanishing for t != 0.
- Survival of the (3,0) class.
- Delta-invariance needed to lift e_{P_3} to G_3.
- Witt comparison: injectivity under W(k)->W(C^flat) via a bounded finite free complex.
- Transport to deformation coefficients. H^3(H,W(k))[1/p] is one-dimensional, so the real content is c_3 != 0, i.e. a != 0 together with c_2 != 0.
- c_2 != 0 via the BSSW retraction.
- Projective-bundle decomposition H^3(M_n) = H^3(P_n) + H^1(P_n)(-1) and the Galois-invariant line argument.
- Drinfeld-side spectral sequence: CDN weights chi^{-j} kill d_2 and d_3 into (3,0).
- Stack identification [P^{n-1}/O_D^x] = [Omega/J_n], by counting fibers of the period maps on degree-0 components.
- Filtered modification: T = P(i_inf^* E_2) is a P^1-bundle, so the projective-bundle lemma applies. The kernel O is unmodified, so V_3 is an extension of O^2 by O, which is O^3.
- Parabolic lemma: Q_p^2 is integrally acyclic (pro-zero tower). H^3 of the Levi Z_p^x x J_2 is 1-dimensional. H^3(SL_n(Q_p),Q_p) is nonzero and restricts nontrivially to compact opens, by a building/Mayer-Vietoris computation for n=2,3. b != 0 follows from the gl_2 block of the trace cocycle.
Taken on trust and not verified: the deep BMR2026 inputs (Spd Lhat = Surj(O(1/3),O(1/2)), acyclicity of constants over P_3^1, E_2 = Bhat^{hP_3^1}, the oriented map E_3 -> Bhat), the solid/condensed foundations, and Appendix A details.
sibling_notes: This agrees with the first-pass entry for this paper and with the companion papers at ranks 202 and 125 (p=3 and the explicit filtration), which also refute the CSC shape at height 3. Conceptually, the theorem is the Lie heuristic that the trace class x_3 of gl_3, restricted to the Levi gl_2 x gl_1 of the (1,2) parabolic, equals x_3 of gl_2. This is realized through Lubin–Tate/Drinfeld duality. In the 2->1 analogue the abelian Levi kills x_3, which is consistent with GHM. The board entry has been overwritten with a combined 2nd-pass summary.
